title: Research: FFmpeg optimization for the analysis and render pipeline
objective: Identify concrete, production-safe FFmpeg command-line optimisations for the AI Media Factory single-node pipeline. Focus on three areas: (1) Hardware acceleration – provide ready-to-use flag sets for NVENC/CUDA, VAAPI, and Vulkan decode paths with detection logic; (2) Audio extraction pipe-mode – show how to pipe 16kHz mono WAV directly to a Whisper process stdin, eliminating the temp-file write; (3) Probe caching – show how to cache ffprobe JSON output in SQLite to avoid redundant probes on retries. For each: exact flag set, fallback for CPU-only hosts, and any known libass subtitle rendering interactions. Write results to docs/research/RESEARCH-FFMPEG-001.md only.
